ms.report:
Warm greetings, esteemed milestone reviewer. I hope you are doing well.
I sincerely appreciate your feedback regarding the first work trial. The promotion and dissemination of the project across various social media platforms have been crucial for the growth of each of them. For this reason, I consistently engage in this activity, as many followers discover one social media platform thanks to its promotion on another, allowing them to access more content, especially regarding YouTube videos.
I do not believe these publications are irrelevant or do not add value to the Cardano ecosystem; if that were the case, I would not be making them. I understand your perspective, but each of these publications aims to expand our social media presence and attract new people to learn about Cardano. Even posts like personal photos are significant due to the high level of interaction they generate, as well as the typical "GM" messages that foster a sense of community within the ecosystem, precisely the purpose of my project.
Of the approximately 30 posts made this month, only 23% are dedicated to promoting content users can find on other social media platforms. This content adds value to the Cardano ecosystem as it is educational and encourages new people within the ecosystem to acquire their first ADAs, which is fundamental to the proposal. Additionally, these posts require time for publication and editing work. I continue to work on social media marketing to meet the objectives of milestone 3.
I kindly ask you to consider my comments in evaluating this first work trial, as the committed posts for the first month have already been made, and it is impossible to modify or add more in August. Furthermore, I have not encountered any issues with this type of content in previous proposals, and it has always been approved without objection.
